# Get Involved

> Become part of The Future: membership, newsletter, donations.

Source: https://die-zukunft.ch/en/join/ · Publisher: The Future (Swiss political party, Basel)

## Join the association

Become a member of The Future association and actively shape the party. All information about membership can be found on our association page.

## Become a member

Membership gives you co-determination, updates and the chance to shape working groups. Write to us at hey@die-zukunft.ch.

## Newsletter

Short, clear, no spam: proposals, events, releases.

## Donate (Open Collective)

Transparent financing, traceable for all. Support The Future via Open Collective.

## Volunteer

Whether writing, organising, design or campaign work — we welcome any support.

## Connect

Do you know experts, organisations or initiatives with similar goals? We actively seek exchange and partnerships.
